title: ehwa-entity-a-tv
label: Viglen

won.source: Won the title from Maverick at the federation's 4 March 1997 pay-per-view, using a fan-supplied chair.

lost.source: No title-change document survives; Justin Blaze is already billed champion by the federation's 12 March 1997 card.

note: The transition from Viglen to Justin Blaze is not documented in the surviving record; named as a gap, not smoothed.

title: ehwa-entity-a-tv
label: Maverick

won.source: Already billed Extreme Television Champion entering the 25 February 1997 card, where he retains against the Playboy.

lost.source: Lost the title to Viglen at the federation's 4 March 1997 pay-per-view.

note: First documented holder on record; no earlier reign is attested.

title: ehwa-entity-a-tv
label: Justin Blaze

won.source: Already billed champion entering the federation's 12 March 1997 card.

note: Retains twice on the 12 March 1997 card (submission win over X-Pert; disqualification over Bloodhound). No further title-change document survives; last documented holder.

title: ehwa-entity-a-world
label: Ivan "Thor" Thunder

won.source: Already billed holding this top championship (called "his Internet championship" this once) at the federation's 25 February 1997 card.

note: Retains at the federation's 12 March 1997 card, there called "the Extreme World Title," defeating Asylum with the Thunderstrike. Sole documented holder; no title change is attested.

title: ehwa-entity-a-internet
label: Playboy Ronnie D.

won.source: Defeated Warlord Chaos for the title at the federation's 12 March 1997 card; the surviving text does not identify a prior champion.

lost.source: No title-change document survives; by 30 November 1997 the title is billed held by Slade Kane.

note: Playboy Ronnie D. is not independently minted (a one-card appearance with no further tenure); recorded by name per the reign format.

won.source: Awarded the vacant title alongside the newly created US Title for winning the Ultimate Survivor Battle Royal.

title: ehwa-entity-a-internet
label: Slade Kane

won.source: No title-win document survives; billed the title's own holder immediately before vacating it.

lost.source: Vacated the title by quitting the federation, announced mid-show at the 30 November 1997 battle royal.

note: Named only in the 30 November 1997 announcement; never appears on-camera in the surviving record. Not minted.

title: ehwa-entity-a-tag
label: The Knights (Darknight & Midnight)

won.source: Already billed World Tag Team Champions entering the federation's 4 March 1997 card.

lost.source: No title-change document survives; Eclipse & Cataclysm are already billed champions by the federation's 12 March 1997 card.

note: Retain by disqualification over the Doggpound at the 4 March 1997 card. The transition to Eclipse & Cataclysm is not documented; named as a gap.

title: ehwa-entity-a-tag
label: Eclipse & Cataclysm

won.source: Already billed World Tag Team Champions entering the federation's 12 March 1997 card.

note: Retain on a restart, with the French Canadians' interference, over the Powers of Destruction at the 12 March 1997 card. Last documented holders.

title: ehwa-entity-a-us
label: "Too Sexy" Christopher Charles

won.source: Won the newly created title by winning the Ultimate Survivor Battle Royal.

note: First and, on record, only documented holder.
